title: How to Use AI for Fast Video Editing - Tech On Tips
author: 9smart
description: Is AI video editing the future? Discover how to use AI tools in 2026 to edit videos faster, improve production quality, and streamline your workflow.
excerpt: Learn the complete AI video editing workflow. From automatic cuts to visual effects, see how AI saves time for creators in 2026.
content:
Video editing was once a bottleneck for content creators. In 2026, AI has eliminated this obstacle, allowing creators to transform hours of raw footage into polished videos in minutes.

How AI Revolutionized Video Editing

Modern tools like Descript analyze full videos to remove silence and unwanted pauses. According to Adobe data released in 2026-07-08, creators who adopted AI in editing reduced production time by an average of 65%.

Main Uses of AI in Video Editing

  • Text-Based Editing: Edit video by deleting words in the transcript.
  • Automatic Pause Removal: Tools like Gling clean audio tracks automatically.
  • Short Clip Generation: Platforms like Opus Clip generate viral-ready content from long videos.

Conclusion

AI video editing is an accessible reality in 2026-07-09. By starting with these tools, independent creators can match professional production speeds.
